goal: Implement the input manager with logical action mapping, keyboard + gamepad support, remap persistence, and a clean event interface for scenes. Defaults per docs/03-TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.2.
constraints: Actions: up, down, left, right, confirm, cancel, menu, act-1, act-2, act-3, act-4, beat-press.
Defaults: WASD = directions; J = confirm, K = cancel, Enter = confirm, Escape = menu; Space = beat-press; UIOP = act-1..act-4.
Gamepad: standard mapping; left-stick + D-pad = directions; A = confirm, B = cancel, Start = menu; X = beat-press; Y = act-2; LB/RB = act-3/act-4.
Repeat behavior: directions emit `held` events with configurable initial-delay (default 250ms) and repeat-rate (default 60ms); confirm/cancel/menu/act-* are press-only by default.
Remap persists to settings storage; getters return the current mapping.
acceptance: Test verifies key-down -> action-pressed; key-up -> action-released; repeat rate matches config within 5ms tolerance.
Gamepad simulation test verifies A button -> confirm.
Remap test verifies binding override is reflected in `pressed()` immediately.
